hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import os, json, sys
try:
    inp = json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT', '{}'))
    path = inp.get('file_path', '')
    if path.endswith('.context.md'):
        model = os.path.basename(path).replace('.context.md', '')
        print(f'\n[hook] Context updated: {model}.context.md — run /regen {model} to regenerate the SQL model.')
except Exception:
    pass
"
